people.name: Ehud
people.line: Left-handed Benjamite judge who delivered Israel from Moabite oppression

people.name: Manahath
people.line: A place where Benjamites lived after the exile

translations.web: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:
translations.bsb: These were the descendants of Ehud who were the heads of the families living in Geba and were exiled to Manahath:
translations.kjv: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
